name: PersonaGym
description: PersonaGym is a dynamic evaluation framework for persona agents, LLM agents conditioned to act according to assigned personas. It enables large-scale evaluation of persona adherence across diverse environments using PersonaScore, a human-aligned automatic metric.
reputation: PersonaGym is a recent benchmark/framework for evaluating persona adherence in LLM agents and is gaining attention in persona-agent research.
notes: Evaluates persona consistency across 200 personas and 10,000 questions; introduces PersonaScore metric.
